_comment: Ground truth for the hard live suites. Same field shape as
reused unchanged -- but expectations are a LIST, scored as a set by
score_activity_set, so a missed sibling and a hallucinated activity both
child_name holds the profile's canonical first name. name_score accepts a
fuller extracted form ('Taylor Nguyen-Smith' for 'Taylor'), so this is the
least-strict correct answer, not a demand for an exact string.
date_resolution declares how a year-less fixture's {Y} token resolves, so
the case stays reproducible as the calendar moves.
